basics.description: **Note:** Please review the following before installing the solution: • Refer to the [Cyolo Sentinel Solution Documentation](https://example.com/cyolo-sentinel-docs) • Check for [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) before installation. The [Cyolo Sentinel Solution](https://example.com) data connector allows ingesting logs from the Cyolo IDAC API into Microsoft Sentinel. It uses the Cyolo IDAC API to fetch logs and supports DCR-based ingestion time transformations for parsing security data into custom tables. **Data Connectors:** 1 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for Cyolo Sentinel Solution. You can get Cyolo IDAC data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

elements.name: dataCollectionEndpointName
elements.label: Data Collection Endpoint Name
elements.toolTip: Enter a unique name for the Data Collection Endpoint

validations.message: Name must be 3-63 characters long and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

options.text: Select which log streams you want to ingest from Cyolo. You can enable or disable individual log streams based on your monitoring requirements. Note: You can modify these settings later if needed.

elements.name: enableAnalyticsLogs
elements.label: Enable Analytics Logs
elements.toolTip: Ingest behavioral analytics data from Cyolo. This includes user activity patterns, access trends, and usage analytics.

elements.name: enableAuditLogs
elements.label: Enable Audit Logs
elements.toolTip: Ingest audit trail data from Cyolo. This includes administrative actions, configuration changes, and compliance events.

elements.name: enableSystemLogs
elements.label: Enable System Logs
elements.toolTip: Ingest system health and operational events from Cyolo. This includes infrastructure status, performance metrics, and system diagnostics.
